title: Water Filling 9 Plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Aspirate maximum amount of water in pipette tip.

steps.title: Configure pipette for multi‑dispense
steps.instruction: Install the multi‑dispensing attachment on the pipette and set it to the pipette’s maximum volume as specified by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Aspirate water from reservoir
steps.instruction: Place the pipette tip in the water reservoir and aspirate the pipette’s maximum amount of water.

steps.title: Dispense 36 µL to all wells
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑dispensing mode, dispense 36 µL of water into every well of all 108 columns across the nine plates.
